reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web interface plugin that adds a vertical rail for previewing and jumping between loaded ordinary user prompts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话视图添加紧凑的纵向提示词导航条，用于预览并跳转到已加载的普通用户提示词。
summaries.en: Adds a compact vertical navigation rail to the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation view for previewing and jumping between loaded ordinary user prompts.

capabilities: Reads loaded ordinary user prompts in the conversation view
Displays prompt previews on hover or keyboard focus
Scrolls the conversation to a selected prompt
